context.summary: Add GPT4All as the 5th production plugin in modeltap (joining ollama, hf, lm-studio, atomic-chat). The Tool trait is frozen at 6 methods per ADR-001; no core changes; this slice exercises the US-18 plugin extensibility contract end-to-end on a real-world tool. Sole context document: docs/feature/gpt4all-plugin/discuss/intake-brief.md. DISCUSS / DESIGN / DISTILL waves are deliberately absent for this small plugin add.

acceptance_criteria_catalog.AC-G1.1: gpt4all slot appears in the left pane (and Healthy in launch.inventory) when at least one default GPT4All dir exists OR MODELTAP_GPT4ALL_DIRS points to an existing dir.
acceptance_criteria_catalog.AC-G1.2: Each *.gguf file in a configured GPT4All dir produces one DiscoveredModel with id_in_tool = filename, format = Format::Gguf, size_bytes from filesystem metadata, display_label derived from the filename without the .gguf extension.
acceptance_criteria_catalog.AC-G1.3: When every configured dir is missing, discover() returns DiscoverError::NotInstalled (not Io); modeltap surfaces it as a benign NotInstalled state and gpt4all is NOT in launch.inventory.tool_errors.
acceptance_criteria_catalog.AC-G1.4: Files that aren't *.gguf (e.g., README.md, .DS_Store, downloads.json) are silently skipped and do not appear in discovery output.
acceptance_criteria_catalog.AC-G1.5: When BOTH the Python SDK dir (~/.cache/gpt4all) and the desktop GUI dir exist and both contain .gguf files, every file from both locations appears in the gpt4all model list.
acceptance_criteria_catalog.AC-G2.1: A GPT4All .gguf with the same SHA256 as an Ollama or HF blob is classified DedupAble (=) by the existing dedup engine without any plugin-side change (cross-tool unify path).
acceptance_criteria_catalog.AC-G2.2: delete_one removes a single targeted .gguf file from disk; delete_all removes every *.gguf from every configured GPT4All dir.
acceptance_criteria_catalog.AC-G3.1: link() creates a hardlink from the canonical source over the GPT4All target path; on EXDEV (cross-filesystem) it falls back to copy per ADR-008.
acceptance_criteria_catalog.AC-G4.1: MODELTAP_GPT4ALL_DIRS (colon-separated) overrides the per-OS default dirs entirely (used by acceptance tests with TempDir). Mirrors MODELTAP_ATOMIC_CHAT_DIRS / MODELTAP_LMSTUDIO_DIRS pattern.
acceptance_criteria_catalog.AC-G5.1: tools_registered in launch.inventory contains exactly 5 names (ollama, hf, lm-studio, Atomic Chat, gpt4all) when the test-fixtures feature is OFF; sorted alphabetically.

phases.name: Phase 01 — GPT4All plugin (discovery + mutation + composition + acceptance)
phases.description: Single-phase plugin add. Each step is atomic and follows the plugins/atomic-chat shape: a Cargo.toml + src/{lib.rs, paths.rs, config.rs, discover.rs} crate that self-registers via inventory::submit!. The composition root picks it up via an `as _` import. The final step lights the per-AC acceptance file green by construction. This phase is structured so that an early kill (e.g. composition root drift) surfaces in step 01-04, well before the acceptance-test step.

steps.name: Create plugins/gpt4all crate skeleton (Cargo.toml + lib.rs + inventory::submit!)
steps.description: Bootstrap the new crate at plugins/gpt4all/. Cargo.toml mirrors plugins/atomic-chat/Cargo.toml (modeltap-core path dep, async-trait, tokio workspace, walkdir, inventory, tracing, dirs, tempfile dev-dep). src/lib.rs declares the Gpt4AllPlugin struct, Tool impl with name() = ToolId("gpt4all"), accepted_formats() = &[Format::Gguf], and stubbed discover/link/delete_one/delete_all returning NotYetImplemented. Single inventory::submit! block at the bottom. The crate compiles and registers but does NOT yet appear in the modeltap-app binary (composition root is wired in step 01-04). Add the crate to the workspace [members] list in /Cargo.toml.
steps.acceptance_test_scenario: (no acceptance scenario yet — skeleton only; first behavioral consumer is step 01-02)
steps.implementation_notes: Pin the package name as `modeltap-plugin-gpt4all` for naming parity with the four siblings. Pure scaffolding step — every Tool method is `Err(DiscoverError|LinkError|DeleteError::NotYetImplemented("..."))` so the trait bound compiles cleanly. The inventory::submit! block belongs in lib.rs (NOT in a submodule) so a single `use modeltap_plugin_gpt4all as _;` in main.rs forces linker inclusion. Do NOT add the crate to crates/modeltap-app/Cargo.toml yet — that's step 01-04, and keeping it deferred means a typo in this step does not break the workspace test run.

steps.name: Implement default-path resolver and config (env-var override + per-OS defaults)
steps.description: Add plugins/gpt4all/src/paths.rs with HostOs enum and default_paths_from_home(os, home) -> Vec<PathBuf> returning BOTH the Python SDK dir (~/.cache/gpt4all) and the desktop GUI dir (~/Library/Application Support/nomic-ai/gpt4all-chat on macOS; ~/.local/share/nomic-ai/gpt4all-chat on Linux/WSL). Add plugins/gpt4all/src/config.rs with from_process_env reading MODELTAP_GPT4ALL_DIRS (colon-separated) and load_config(env) -> Config { search_paths }. Override pattern: env-var present → use exclusively; absent → per-OS defaults. Wire Gpt4AllPlugin::new() to consume load_config and store search_paths.
steps.acceptance_test_scenario: Unit tests in paths.rs cover macOS resolution (both dirs), Linux resolution (both dirs), absent $HOME (empty Vec). Unit tests in config.rs cover env-var-only, defaults-only, env-var-overrides-defaults.
steps.implementation_notes: Per intake brief storage layout (verified 2026-05-02): always emit BOTH default dirs even when only one exists — discover_in handles the missing-dir case. Mirror plugins/atomic-chat/src/paths.rs structure exactly (HostOs enum, host_os() free function, default_paths_from_home(os, home) pure function, resolve_default_paths() production helper). The env-var override REPLACES defaults (not unions) — simpler than atomic-chat's TOML+env union, and matches MODELTAP_OLLAMA_DIR / MODELTAP_LMSTUDIO_DIRS pattern. No TOML config support in v1 (intake brief makes no mention).

steps.name: Implement discover() — walk *.gguf files in configured dirs
steps.description: Add plugins/gpt4all/src/discover.rs with discover_in(roots: &[PathBuf]) -> Result<Vec<DiscoveredModel>, DiscoverError>. For each existing root, enumerate top-level entries (depth = 1, follow_links = false), filter to *.gguf files (case-insensitive extension match), and emit one DiscoveredModel per file: id_in_tool = filename (with .gguf), on_disk_path = absolute path, size_bytes = std::fs::metadata().len(), format = Format::Gguf, display_label = filename without .gguf extension, status = ModelStatus::Healthy. When NO root exists, return DiscoverError::NotInstalled. Empty existing root → Ok(Vec::new()). Sort by id_in_tool. Wire from Tool::discover via tokio::task::spawn_blocking (per ADR-005, mirroring atomic-chat).
steps.acceptance_test_scenario: Unit tests cover: (1) two .gguf files in one root → 2 models, sorted; (2) all roots missing → NotInstalled; (3) empty existing root → Ok(empty); (4) non-.gguf files (README, .DS_Store, downloads.json) silently skipped; (5) two roots both populated → union of both, sorted; (6) size_bytes matches std::fs::metadata.
quality_gates: cargo test -p modeltap-plugin-gpt4all discover green (≥ 5 unit tests)
discover never panics on permission-denied entries
steps.implementation_notes: Simpler than atomic-chat — no manifest layer, no Corrupt status path. Pure flat directory walk. Use walkdir with max_depth(1) (mirrors atomic-chat's pattern) so a stray subdirectory of .gguf files inside the root does NOT recurse. Skip dotfiles by filtering file_name.starts_with('.'). Case-insensitive extension match: file_name.to_ascii_lowercase().ends_with(".gguf"). On std::fs::metadata error for an individual file, log via tracing::debug and skip the file (do NOT abort the scan and do NOT emit Corrupt — GPT4All has no manifest concept of corruption). The Tool::discover wrapper around spawn_blocking is identical to atomic-chat.

steps.name: Wire gpt4all into composition root (Cargo.toml dep + main.rs use _ import)
steps.description: Add modeltap-plugin-gpt4all = { path = "../../plugins/gpt4all" } to crates/modeltap-app/Cargo.toml [dependencies] (NOT optional). Add `use modeltap_plugin_gpt4all as _;` to crates/modeltap-app/src/main.rs alongside the existing four `as _` plugin imports. Verify via `cargo run --bin modeltap -- --headless --quit-after-paint` that launch.inventory.tools_registered now contains "gpt4all" alongside the four existing plugins. No production-code changes beyond these two lines — inventory::iter pickup is automatic.
steps.acceptance_test_scenario: After this step, a smoke `cargo run --bin modeltap -- --headless --quit-after-paint --no-default-features` writes a launch.log whose launch.inventory event lists exactly 5 tools_registered: ["Atomic Chat", "gpt4all", "hf", "lm-studio", "ollama"] (sorted).
quality_gates: cargo build -p modeltap-app --no-default-features green (verifies gpt4all loads without test-fixtures feature)
smoke run writes launch.inventory with 5 tools_registered
steps.implementation_notes: Two lines in two files. The composition root deliberately knows the static plugin set (per ADR-001); discovery via inventory::iter::<PluginFactory>() picks up the new factory automatically with no main.rs logic change. Add the dep BEFORE the test-fixtures fixture line in Cargo.toml so the production plugin grouping stays contiguous. If existing tests assert `tools_registered.len() == 4` anywhere, they MUST be updated in step 01-06 (architecture-test sweep) — do NOT silently weaken assertions in this step.

steps.name: Implement link() / delete_one() / delete_all() and unit-test them
steps.description: Replace the NotYetImplemented stubs in src/lib.rs with real implementations. link(canonical_src, model): hardlink canonical_src → model.on_disk_path; on EXDEV, fall back to std::fs::copy per ADR-008; return LinkOutcome with the resolved strategy. delete_one(model): std::fs::remove_file(&model.on_disk_path); return DeleteOutcome with the freed bytes. delete_all(): for each configured root that exists, enumerate *.gguf and remove each; return Vec<DeleteOutcome> in deletion order. All three methods wrap their I/O in tokio::task::spawn_blocking. Add a plugins/gpt4all/tests/mutation_test.rs with unit tests covering: hardlink success, EXDEV fallback to copy (using two tempdirs on same fs is fine — just verify the success path; injecting a real EXDEV in tests is out of scope), delete_one success, delete_one ENOENT → DeleteError::NotFound, delete_all empties the configured dirs.
steps.acceptance_test_scenario: Unit tests in plugins/gpt4all/tests/mutation_test.rs cover hardlink, delete_one happy path + ENOENT, delete_all clears every configured dir.
quality_gates: EXDEV fallback path documented (even if not exercised in tests)
steps.implementation_notes: Reuse the cross-fs hardlink helper if one already exists in modeltap-core (check `core::fs::hardlink_or_copy` or similar). Otherwise inline the std::fs::hard_link → io::ErrorKind::CrossesDevices match → std::fs::copy fallback per ADR-008. delete_all order: deterministic (sort filenames within each root, then iterate roots in config order) so the JSONL audit trail is reproducible. Do NOT recurse into subdirs in delete_all — GPT4All's storage is flat by design. Errors from individual files in delete_all are surfaced as a DeleteError::Partial { successes, failures } variant if it exists, OR as the first error encountered (match what existing plugins do — quick grep needed at implementation time).

steps.name: Sweep architecture-test plugin-count assertions and headless plugin-env carving
steps.description: Two coordinated edits: (1) Update any architecture-lint test (likely crates/modeltap-app/tests/architecture.rs) that asserts a plugin count to expect 5 production plugins instead of 4. Search for `tools_registered.len() ==` and `plugin_count` literals across crates/modeltap-app/tests/. (2) Update the `modeltap_headless()` helper in tests/acceptance/us_atomic_chat_discovery.rs (and any other acceptance test that pins ALL plugin env vars to /nonexistent) to also pin MODELTAP_GPT4ALL_DIRS=/nonexistent/no-such-gpt4all so existing tests stay isolated from the developer's real $HOME after this plugin lands.
steps.acceptance_test_scenario: After this step, full workspace test (cargo test --workspace) is green: existing US-01..US-20 + US-05b + US-atomic-chat-discovery acceptance tests all pass with the new 5th plugin in place.
quality_gates: every prior acceptance test still passes (zero regressions)
steps.implementation_notes: Run `grep -rn 'tools_registered' crates/modeltap-app/tests/` and `grep -rn '/nonexistent/no-such-' crates/modeltap-app/tests/` to enumerate the surface area. Most likely 1–3 assertion sites + 1–2 env-var helpers. If a test uses a 4-element exact-equality on the sorted tools_registered list, expand to 5 elements with "gpt4all" inserted in alphabetical position (between "Atomic Chat" and "hf"). Do NOT touch test ASSERTIONS that exercise non-plugin-count behavior — keep the diff surgical. If grep finds zero plugin-count assertions, the step still owns the env-var carving change.

steps.name: Add us_gpt4all_discovery acceptance test — green by construction
steps.description: Create crates/modeltap-app/tests/acceptance/us_gpt4all_discovery.rs mirroring us_atomic_chat_discovery.rs. Three scenarios: (1) gpt4all_models_are_discovered — fixture with 2 .gguf files in a TempDir, MODELTAP_GPT4ALL_DIRS=tempdir, assert models.log contains 2 entries with tool="gpt4all", format="Gguf", and size_bytes matches the fixture. (2) gpt4all_not_installed_shows_benign_message — MODELTAP_GPT4ALL_DIRS pinned at /nonexistent (default in modeltap_headless helper), assert "gpt4all" NOT in launch.inventory.tool_errors and zero models.log entries with tool="gpt4all". (3) gpt4all_two_dirs_both_walked — two TempDirs, each with one .gguf, MODELTAP_GPT4ALL_DIRS="dir1:dir2", assert 2 models surfaced. NO #[ignore] — tests should be green by construction on the back of 01-01..01-06.
steps.acceptance_test_scenario: Three acceptance scenarios drive the modeltap headless binary against synthetic GPT4All fixtures and assert against launch.log + models.log JSONL events (driven port boundary).
quality_gates: test runtime < 10s per scenario (timeout matches us_atomic_chat_discovery)
steps.implementation_notes: Copy us_atomic_chat_discovery.rs verbatim and adapt: replace tool name "Atomic Chat" → "gpt4all", env var name MODELTAP_ATOMIC_CHAT_DIRS → MODELTAP_GPT4ALL_DIRS, fixture writer to write a flat .gguf file (no model.yml subdir layout), and the third scenario pivots from yml-parse-error to two-dirs-both-walked (since GPT4All has no manifest layer to corrupt). Reuse the modeltap_headless() helper pattern; add MODELTAP_GPT4ALL_DIRS to its env-pin list (already done in 01-06). Add the test module to crates/modeltap-app/tests/acceptance/mod.rs (or whatever the existing module-list mechanism is — follow the us_atomic_chat_discovery precedent exactly).

steps.name: Add cross-tool dedup acceptance test (gpt4all + ollama same SHA256 → unify)
steps.description: Add a single acceptance test crates/modeltap-app/tests/acceptance/us_gpt4all_cross_tool_unify.rs that verifies a GPT4All .gguf and an Ollama blob with identical SHA256 are classified DedupAble (=) by the existing dedup engine and can be unified via the existing actions::unify::run path. Fixture: write the same byte payload to both a TempDir-rooted GPT4All dir AND an Ollama blobs/sha256 dir; pin MODELTAP_GPT4ALL_DIRS and MODELTAP_OLLAMA_DIR; drive headless with --quit-after-paint AND a hash-complete sentinel; assert (a) both rows show the = glyph in the rendered right-pane snapshot OR models.log shows shared dedup_key, and (b) actions::unify::run produces one hardlink (verify via inode equality post-run).
steps.acceptance_test_scenario: GPT4All blob with same SHA256 as an Ollama blob is dedup-classified and unifies via the existing flow.
quality_gates: post-unify inode equality holds (proves hardlink succeeded)
steps.implementation_notes: Reuse the cross-tool-model-unify hash-complete sentinel (per its roadmap step 01-09) so the test waits deterministically for SHA256 hashing to finish before asserting glyph state. The headless script pattern: '<wait-paint><hash-complete><snapshot-right-pane>' or scripted u-keypress for the unify path. Look at crates/modeltap-app/tests/acceptance/us_u1_walking_skeleton.rs for the exact sentinel syntax and assertion shape. If hash sentinel availability is uncertain, simpler variant: assert via models.log that both GPT4All and Ollama entries share the same dedup_key (computed by the dedup engine), then exit — skip the actual unify run. This step is small but exercises the FULL value proposition of adding GPT4All (cross-tool wins) so it is in-scope, not optional.

out_of_scope: LoRA / adapter file discovery (intake brief: only .gguf in v1)
Chat history / conversation file surfacing (irrelevant to model storage)
GPT4All downloads.json metadata cache parsing (filesystem size is sufficient)
Network probing or remote model catalog calls (discovery is local fs only)
Native Windows support (WSL only per project constraint #6 in CLAUDE.md)
[plugins.gpt4all] TOML config section (env var override is sufficient for v1; can be added later if user demand emerges)

validation.reviewer: auto-approved (small plugin add following established Tool trait contract per ADR-001)
validation.rationale: Plugin contract is frozen at 6 methods on the Tool trait per ADR-001. Architecture is unchanged. Acceptance scenarios mirror the existing us_atomic_chat_discovery.rs pattern. The plugins/atomic-chat/ template is well-established (newest production plugin, all conventions documented in its source). No DISCUSS/DESIGN/DISTILL waves are needed for this small, well-bounded plugin add. Roadmap follows the standard nw-deliver phase / step / dependency / quality-gate schema.
